title: API example doesn't open new window when button clicked (crashes on `--release`)
body:
**Describe the bug** API example crashes when clicking "New Window" in a release build. Debug builds generate the same error, but does not crash the window. **To Reproduce** 1. Check out latest dev (59784c7e5587ff10d7f0c37ac414499da42d0707 at the time of writing) 2. Run `cargo run --bin api` (release and backtrace optional) 3. Click the "Window" tab on the left side 4. Click "New window" button 5. See backtrace and no new window (or crash if running release). **Expected behavior** A new window to open. **Platform and Versions (please complete the following information):** OS: `5.12.10-arch1-1 x86_64 GNU/Linux` Rustc: `rustc 1.52.1 (9bc8c42bb 2021-05-09)` **Stack Trace** ``` ➜ tauri git:(dev) RUST_BACKTRACE=full cargo run --bin api Compiling api v0.1.0 (/home/chip/code/tauri-apps/tauri/examples/api/src-tauri) Finished dev [unoptimized + debuginfo] target(s) in 15.30s Running `target/debug/api` thread 'tokio-runtime-worker' panicked at 'GTK may only be used from the main thread.', /home/chip/.cargo/registry/src/github.com-1ecc6299db9ec823/gtk-0.9.2/src/auto/menu_item.rs:48:9 stack backtrace: 0: 0x55d62996ede0 -
